title: Ehrenborg–Morel–Readdy's conjecture on pizza quantities for Coxeter arrangements
statement: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be a Coxeter arrangement on a finite-dimensional inner product space $V$, let $a\in V$, and let $R$ satisfy $\|a\|\leq R$. Assume that the number of hyperplanes of $\mathcal{H}$ is greater than $\dim(V)$ and has parity different from $\dim(V)$. **Ehrenborg–Morel–Readdy's conjecture.** The pizza quantity $P(\mathcal{H},\mathbb{B}(a,R))$ is zero if and only if the center $a$ lies on one of the hyperplanes of $\mathcal{H}$. This conjecture addresses the parity cases not covered by the known vanishing theorem; the supplied text does not establish the assertion, so its resolution remains open.
source_name: Richard Ehrenborg, “Conjectures for cutting pizza with Coxeter arrangements”, arXiv:2410.13593 (2024).
